description: Create a quote as a DRAFT. Needs a real sender: billingEntityId from list_billing_entities, or create_billing_entity first with data the user gives you, never invented. Example: date "2026-11-04", billingClientId from list_billing_clients, positions [{description: "Design workshop", quantity: 2, unit: "days", unitPriceNet: 1200}]. Use estimate_quote first to price a scope. The quote is never sent automatically; sending needs a human approval in the app. The legacy `data` JSON string (document field names) is still accepted.

billingEntityId.description: Sender, from list_billing_entities. Left out, the company settings are the sender, not the default entity

data.description: Legacy: JSON object of quote fields; typed fields win

sourceDealId.description: CRM deal the quote belongs to
